reviewer.role: independent evaluator, not candidate author or rescue

stage_pin_status: queue stage pin recorded; opaque stage manifest not read/independently rehashed

eligibility.carrier_completeness: current report/protocol/eligibility/brief/plan/source present; actual source-view/acquisition artifacts intentionally locked

coverage_meaning: Every material current assertion, repeated occurrence, assigned facet, negative condition, omission, novelty and unexecuted test assessed; completeness is not correctness. Related atomic assertions share rows only when their source outcome matches. Actual process assertions explicitly unresolved, not silently accepted.

claims.claim: Standalone report contains every assigned finding; no assigned area remains unvisited.
claims.reason: Reading every line does not establish semantic coverage. All six facets are assessed below, but five retain material gaps; the report also misstates calibration. Actual read coverage remains unknown.

claims.claim: Report date is 2026-10-01 and report is current.
claims.reason: Date agrees with task environment; report is the queued frozen current artifact. Embedded opaque case/treatment label is recorded as a blinding limitation rather than independently validated.

claims.claim: Catalog admits exactly S003 and prohibits live fetching; no other admitted source exists.
claims.reason: Complete catalog and task scope match the assertion. This establishes admitted scope only, not worldwide absence.

claims.claim: No live fetches/searches/delegation/other tools were attempted or needed.
claims.reason: No-fetch constraint is verified; actual operations are not admitted at phase 1. Tool/history claims cannot be proved from a current report.

claims.claim: S003 pin is SHA 5d8b240877ed2cf9596566187bcb3779ea011d5319807134c65e2e7dc2ae82de, 36980 bytes, 896 lines.
claims.reason: Reviewer computed the full byte hash and dimensions; they match the catalog.

claims.claim: Read-file metadata equals original/view hash and original-byte parser-null catalog binding.
claims.reason: The original/view hashes and original_bytes/null binding are supported; the claimed tool-return metadata cannot be checked in phase 1.

claims.claim: Title, Final Community Group Report date, three displayed version URLs, released 0.5 and ome.version 0.5.
claims.reason: All identity tokens occur at cited lines. This does not assert that a live page currently matches.

claims.claim: Version history tops out at 0.5.2 dated 2025-01-10.
claims.reason: Frozen rendering has that highest listed revision/date, separate from metadata version 0.5.

claims.claim: Four capture-only aliases; only one URL is recorded and three origins are unrecorded.
claims.reason: Alias count, identifiers, URL and capture-only version pins match.

claims.claim: Static dependency records matching source/version/permissions/parser/settings/applicability/catalog hash; no automatic runtime selector is claimed.
claims.reason: Every supplied binding matches the exact prebound bytes. This validates static metadata only.

claims.claim: RFC2119 keywords govern; exceptions to normative text are informative sections/examples/pseudocode.
claims.reason: Keyword rule is supported. The exact conformance rule also excludes notes; example pseudocode is informative and does not create a mandatory selector UI.

claims.claim: S003 locators are one-based source lines and equal produced-view line fields.
claims.reason: One-based source locators are usable and were checked against actual source. Equality with produced views is an unverified process assertion.

claims.claim: Only bounded MCP tools were used; six files were read completely.
claims.reason: Actual reads/tools/order are history evidence and remain locked. Prebound inputs show availability, not execution.

claims.claim: TASK.md is 9/9 lines.
claims.reason: Exact preexecution TASK.md has 11 lines, not 9. This defeats the stated numerical full-file witness, without proving how much was actually read.

claims.claim: Brief 5 lines, catalog 40, dependency 14, plan 11 and S003 896.
claims.reason: These input dimensions match; whether read in full is unresolved under P001.

claims.claim: Q1 cold line_map produced specified path, 61299 bytes, SHA efd3f618..., source SHA 5d8b2408...; no prior cache/views.
claims.reason: No view bytes or operation receipt are admitted during current-only grading.

claims.claim: Q1 JSON view is a one-line 1:1 source map; entire read occurred; display ended at entry 554 and entries 1-554 matched.
claims.reason: Representation, read coverage, display truncation and equality require locked view/history bytes.

claims.claim: Q2 cache_source copied Q1 byte-identically at specified hash/size; Q1 cold work was counted in both arms.
claims.reason: Operation, artifact equality and arm accounting cannot be established from frozen source metadata. Economics/method comparison remains unassessed.

claims.claim: Independent Q2 read/equal SHA verified matching views; source tail 554-896 was fully inspected.
claims.reason: Actual view inspection and tail read are not available current-phase evidence.

claims.claim: Two render_sections attempts failed with ValueError/JSONDecodeError, no outputs/retries/hashes.
claims.reason: Failure, no-output, retry and returned-hash claims await phase 2.

claims.claim: All quoted hashes are tool-returned.
claims.reason: Some hashes match admitted bytes; their tool-return provenance is not currently provable.

claims.claim: Acquisition.json records all operations and required views were produced and verified.
claims.reason: Acquisition path is only a reference; file was not opened. It cannot repair current semantics.

claims.claim: OME-Zarr 0.5 is a Zarr v3 hierarchy; image group zarr.json attributes contain multiscales and omero.
claims.reason: v3 and group layout supported. OME keys sit under attributes.ome and omero is optional, as later correctly stated in the report.

claims.claim: Resolution arrays have arbitrary names; use metadata datasets paths/order rather than directory-name inference or sorting.
claims.reason: Metadata paths and highest-to-lowest ordering are normative; folder-name ordering is not authoritative.

claims.claim: Images are 2-5 dimensional with time before channel before spatial axes; dimension guards can inform controls.
claims.reason: Bounds/order supported; control-allocation guard is a sensible product inference, not an observed implementation.

claims.claim: OME keys are attributes.ome, string version, hierarchy-consistent; validate version on opening as a comprehension gate.
claims.reason: Format rule and source-to-plan gate are grounded. Legacy support is not established by this source.

claims.claim: bioformats2raw.layout is transitional series metadata and conforming layout value is 3.
claims.reason: Condition is conforming bioformats2raw collection groups, not every possible root image.

claims.claim: OME series paths govern image order, which must match XML Image order.
claims.reason: Matching XML order is required if OME/METADATA.ome.xml is provided; line 35/92 omit this condition. Path ordering remains required by series/group indexing.

claims.claim: Consecutive groups starting 0 apply only absent series and plate; multiscales groups map to OME-XML Images.
claims.reason: Negative conditions and numbering are preserved.

claims.claim: Plate takes precedence over coexisting layout key; collections and plates cannot be mixed.
claims.reason: Explicit source constraint is retained.

claims.claim: Readers SHOULD disclose multiple images, SHOULD NOT silently open first only, MAY use series/show all/offer choice.
claims.reason: MUST/SHOULD/MAY strengths are preserved. MAY ignore other root groups is omitted but not contradicted.

claims.claim: HCS requires plate-row-well hierarchy; wells contain fields; listing can enumerate wells/fields/acquisitions.
claims.reason: Hierarchy and field semantics supported. Full HCS browsing is an explicit capability recommendation under the thin plan, not a universal UI mandated by the format.

claims.claim: Plate MUST columns/rows/version/wells; SHOULD field_count/name; paths and 0-based indices must agree.
claims.reason: Obligation strengths, path composition and index consistency match. Other name/path validation rules are not claimed here.

claims.claim: Well images/path are mandatory and acquisition is required when multiple acquisitions exist.
claims.reason: Conditional requirement is preserved; acquisition value must match plate entry (omitted detail, not false).

claims.claim: Empty row/well groups SHOULD NOT exist; tolerate absence.
claims.reason: Physical rows/columns metadata still includes empty positions; absence refers to empty groups, correctly separated from metadata.

claims.claim: Nested labels container must have labels paths; all label images SHOULD be listed, so incomplete listing can occur.
claims.reason: Key presence and list completeness have distinct strengths, preserved by the report.

claims.claim: Every dataset shares dimensionality 2-5 corresponding to axes.
claims.reason: Rule applies within the multiscales dictionary.

claims.claim: Multiple named multiscales permit name selection with first fallback.
claims.reason: Name is SHOULD and source presents permissive selection/example fallback; this does not require every file to have names.

claims.claim: A selector UI is required whenever len(multiscales)>1.
claims.reason: No selector-UI MUST exists. This is a product choice promoted to a requirement despite the informative fallback example.

claims.claim: Axes names are mandatory unique; type/unit recommended, custom types allowed; rank and array dimension_names must match.
claims.reason: Correct distinctions and array-level identity checks. Names are arbitrary, but axis role cannot always be resolved by type alone.

claims.claim: Informative chunk-size comment hints pyramid-level choice.
claims.reason: The loop chooses among multiscales entries and then their dataset list; comment suggests which multiscale to default to, not which pyramid level. Read-amplification/level policy itself remains unresolved.

claims.claim: Each dataset requires transformations/exactly one scale in physical units/time or relative factor only when unavailable/inapplicable.
claims.reason: The first source sentence is right, but report replaces unavailable-or-inapplicable with does-not-apply only; the relative fallback is conditional, not universal.

claims.claim: Absolute calibration for every level equals level-0 size composed with per-level relative factors; treating level-k scale as absolute is wrong.
claims.reason: Dataset scale normally already specifies pixel size. Source example scales are 0.5,1,2 micrometers; multiplying level-1 scale by level-0 0.5 produces 0.5 instead of 1. Relative factors are used only when physical scaling is unavailable/inapplicable. Group transforms still apply after dataset transforms.

claims.claim: Dataset MAY have exactly one translation after scale; vector lengths equal axes; transformations apply sequentially.
claims.reason: All ordering, cardinality and length constraints are correct.

claims.claim: Only scale/translation are permitted here; identity is default; vectors may be inline or binary path.
claims.reason: General transform table supports identity default/vector paths. A multiscales dataset still MUST contain exactly one scale; implicit identity does not excuse an absent required scale.

claims.claim: Multiscales transforms optionally apply after dataset transforms to all levels, including shared time scale 0.1 ms.
claims.reason: Order and exact example vector match. Correct rule is retained despite conflicting level-0 multiplication.

claims.claim: Units are axis-specific valid UDUNITS strings; example t milliseconds and z/y/x micrometers; never assume micrometers.
claims.reason: Unit recommendation and example supported. Units are SHOULD rather than always present; report does not specify an unknown/unitless coordinate state or relative calibration warning.

claims.claim: Axis array order is time, channel/custom, spatial; zyx SHOULD for anisotropic stacking z.
claims.reason: Ordering and conditional recommendation match.

claims.claim: Plane z and time t indexing must be driven by axis type, never name or fixed position.
claims.reason: Validated axis identity and optional types inform slicing. All spatial axes share type space, so type alone cannot identify the stacking plane; type may also be absent/custom. Absolute never-name rule discards useful validated identity without supplying a plane mapping.

claims.claim: omero is optional/transitional; channels match c dimension; color is 6 hex RGB; window requires min/max/start/end.
claims.reason: Optional container and required-if-present fields are correctly separated.

claims.claim: active/label/inverted/family/coefficient examples; rdefs T/Z/model provide initial defaults when present.
claims.reason: Examples show these meanings. Universal required reader behavior/default initialization is a product recommendation rather than an independently demonstrated normative obligation; rdefs itself is not required.

claims.claim: Absent omero is normal; fallback channel/T/Z settings need product decision.
claims.reason: No required omero metadata is fabricated. Display fallback is product-owned.

claims.claim: Labels must use the eight integer types uint8/int8 through uint64/int64; intermediate groups allowed but metadata forbidden.
claims.reason: Exact datatype domain and negative metadata constraint match. Precision implications are omitted, assessed as C06 gap.

claims.claim: Label image requires multiscales with same datasets-level count as original.
claims.reason: Count parity is mandatory.

claims.claim: Equal pyramid level count means overlays align level-for-level without resampling.
claims.reason: Count parity does not guarantee identical shapes/grids/origins. Source says usually same dimensions/transforms and permits length-one irrelevant dimensions. Corresponding geometry must be checked or explicitly unsupported.

claims.claim: image-label SHOULD contain colors/version, with required array/string types and integer label-value keys.
claims.reason: image-label, colors and version are all SHOULD-presence; type constraints become mandatory when keys exist. Report compresses these into image-label with colors/version but later recommendations do not universally require palette presence.

claims.claim: rgba is optional four integers 0-255; fourth alpha; readers SHOULD use declared colors; example 50% blue/opacity.
claims.reason: Values and recommendation strength preserved.

claims.claim: Properties are optional label-value-keyed arbitrary objects, not required uniform key sets.
claims.reason: Categorical keying is correctly captured; lookup precision/range not addressed.

claims.claim: Source linkage image is relative to source image group, default ../../.
claims.reason: If source is present it MUST be object and image, if present, MUST be relative-path string. Default is retained; intermediate groups can require explicit relative paths rather than treating parent as source.

claims.claim: Label inspector can surface properties and link back to parent image.
claims.reason: Property inspector is optional product choice. Source reference can identify a different/non-parent image; resolve declared image path before claiming parent association.

claims.claim: Each label dimension should match source dimension or be one when irrelevant.
claims.reason: Source recommendation preserved, not a mandatory exact-shape guarantee.

claims.claim: Overlay slicing must broadcast length-one dimensions, e.g. 2D label over 3D image.
claims.reason: Broadcasting is a suitable supported-overlay behavior; the 2D/3D shorthand still needs explicit validated dimension mapping (e.g. singleton stacking axis), not rank inference. Support breadth remains a product decision.

claims.claim: JSON examples contain explanatory comments; real JSON objects MUST NOT contain comments.
claims.reason: Format prohibition is explicit and valid independently of example content.

claims.claim: Viewer JSON parser must reject or clearly report comment-bearing files.
claims.reason: Reporting/rejecting malformed input is source-to-plan policy. S003 does not separately mandate a specific reader rejection algorithm; lenient acceptance remains invalid-format handling.

claims.claim: Thin plan omits explicit series/plates, so image listing should cover three topologies.
claims.reason: Text omission is verified. Three-topology breadth is a reasonable capability proposal requiring product review rather than proof every local fileset must be fully rendered.

claims.claim: Plan overlays implemented using declared labels/colors, parity and singleton broadcast.
claims.reason: Discovery/palette/broadcast are grounded choices. Parity alone is insufficient registration (R013-F08); source identity/transforms must be validated.

claims.claim: Details panel needs composed calibration, axes and units.
claims.reason: Need for geometry is supported; universal relative-scale claim is contradicted under R013-F06, and absent units are not specified.

claims.claim: Background reads/cancellation/errors are product requirements; S003 specifies no error taxonomy/async behavior.
claims.reason: Full source reviewed for counterevidence. Format text defines no async UI policy or error taxonomy.

claims.claim: Version inconsistency, JSON comments, missing dimension_names, transform vector lengths and label-level mismatch are grounded malformed-input feedback cases.
claims.reason: Each malformed condition is anchored; feedback expectation comes from plan rather than observed execution.

claims.claim: Source files unchanged/session-local display settings; omero adjustments must not be written back.
claims.reason: Preserves negative read-only/editing/export/remote-service boundaries relevant to the plan.

claims.claim: Only captured 0.5/v3 obligations are evidenced; earlier version transfer is not established.
claims.reason: Correct version limit and no live extrapolation.

claims.claim: 0.4 and earlier are Zarr-v2-based per version history lines 834-848.
claims.reason: History says 0.5.0 uses v3 but cited earlier entries do not specify v2, and no v2 text is admitted. Likely external knowledge is still unsupported in this fixed corpus.

claims.claim: All findings are format obligations/permissions from a normative document.
claims.reason: Report includes informative examples, product choices and unsupported mandates. Normative document identity does not make every conclusion normative.

claims.claim: No admitted implementation/fileset/performance/writer-behavior evidence; real-tool interoperability cannot be inferred.
claims.reason: The single admitted source has a pointer only for implementations. Source includes illustrative layouts, not observed runtime evidence.

claims.claim: Transitional metadata intended for future removal; reading can be MUST/SHOULD.
claims.reason: General conditional reading duty matches; no concrete universal duty fabricated. Architecture avoidance is optional planning guidance.

claims.claim: SHOULD/MAY metadata need not be guaranteed in every fileset; graceful fallbacks are appropriate.
claims.reason: Optional/recommended constraints allow justified departures; lack of any required value is still malformed. Fall-back policy is product-owned.

claims.claim: Plate version is MUST, well version only SHOULD.
claims.reason: Asymmetric requirement preserved.

claims.claim: Zarr mechanics/read amplification are unprovided and unresolved.
claims.reason: Admitted capture permits Zarr features but does not describe full Zarr internals; level-choice hint is separately misinterpreted (R013-F05).

claims.claim: Display semantics for custom/null axis types are unspecified.
claims.reason: Custom/null axis allowance exists without a full UI mapping; claim is bounded to this source.

claims.claim: No worked numeric time-calibration example beyond group-scale example is present.
claims.reason: Full scale vectors are shown across levels and group, but no evaluated pixel coordinate/translation arithmetic is given. This is a valid unresolved validation need, not permission to misapply scale.

claims.claim: All six admitted inputs and both view files were read end-to-end.
claims.reason: Prebound files exist, but actual reading history is locked. Same claim is P001/P005/P007; semantically unvisited gaps are documented, not repaired by asserted read coverage.

claims.claim: V1 real-writer filesets for three topologies: proposed UNEXECUTED discovery check.
claims.reason: Valid future interoperability test; names of tools are leads, not evidence they actually emit suitable filesets. No executed result or existing fixture is claimed.

claims.claim: V2 malformed-input suite should produce feedback rather than crash.
claims.reason: Valid unexecuted plan test; no lack-of-fixture failure is charged.

claims.claim: V3 calibration audit uses per-level relative factor multiplied by level-0 size, then group/order.
claims.reason: Test remains UNEXECUTED, but its proposed universal oracle embeds the same incorrect calibration rule as R013-F06; execution is not invented.

claims.claim: V4 scan unlisted labels and broadcast singleton dimensions.
claims.reason: Valid optional traversal/broadcast proposal, not a format MUST. Source association/geometry validation and exact categorical precision still missing.

claims.claim: V5 large-pyramid responsiveness and cancellation.
claims.reason: Valid unexecuted product acceptance; no performance result claimed.

claims.claim: V6 absent-omero defaults usability test.
claims.reason: Valid unexecuted product-choice test, not a required format palette.

Validated spatial-plane role mapping when all spatial axes have type space
facets.reason: Identity validation is useful, but type-alone plane indexing is unsupported and singleton label broadcasting does not solve absent image dimensions.

omissions: Nonuniform/anisotropic reductions not worked through correctly
facets.reason: Order/arbitrary names retained, but missing-level case and general level geometry are incomplete; incorrect level-0 multiplication is material.

omissions: Concrete evaluated coordinate with offsets and group scale
facets.reason: Correct composition ordering coexists with contradicted universal relative-scale rule. Proposed V3 has no numeric oracle and repeats the wrong rule.

omissions: Resolve explicit source reference before attaching overlay, including intermediate groups/different origins
facets.reason: Source path and level count are mentioned, but parity is incorrectly treated as resampling-free alignment and parent association is overgeneralized.

Avoid interpolation creating new categorical IDs

blinding_limits: Current report line 4 exposes case/treatment/method label; lines 13,17-28,117-119 embed mechanism/process identity, operation claims and arm wording
Current source locator/format conventions and root role naming visible
No other candidate context, prior grades, acquisition/history, economics, private mapping or lab files were accessed

test_execution_status: All V1-V6 are explicitly UNEXECUTED; no execution results inferred. V3 proposed oracle is factually defective independent of execution.
source_fit: Good citation density and fixed capture binding; no implementation/live/other-version empirical support. Material source interpretations fail as identified.
plan_fit: Useful source-to-thin-plan proposals and negative read-only constraints; mandatory selector and geometry/calibration inferences exceed support. Additional breadth needs product review.
standalone_coherence: Standalone findings survive without opening acquisition; calibration rule conflicts with source and correct composition statements; label alignment and plane rules overgeneralize.
comparison_status: No method/economics comparison permitted or made; quality failure is separate from complete assessment.
